stemMd: What is the midpoint of the segment joining (−4,7) and (6,−1)?
explanationMd: Average corresponding coordinates: (−4+6)/2=1 and (7−1)/2=3. The resulting point lies halfway along the segment.

distractorRationale.e: This sums coordinates without dividing by two.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses both signs of the average.
distractorRationale.a: This takes half the differences rather than averages.
